name: character-pack
description: The characters World Studio can place: coworker_cyan, coworker_gold, coworker_red, hunter, raider, raider2 and ninja - Kenney's CC0 Blocky Characters, recoloured for The Nightshift and 99 Nights, each with 27 animations (idle, walk, sprint, attack-melee-right, holding-right-shoot, die, pick-up, emote-yes ...) - plus box animals (wolf, bear, deer) with no animations. The .glb files live in this plugin folder, so `model3d hunter = "hunter.glb"` finds them from any program without copying anything, and any other .glb dropped in here shows up in World Studio's Character list. See README.md.

snippets.label: Characters (walk, turn, animate)
snippets.description: Normally used as `import "characters.volt"`. Turns a placed model into an actor that walks to a point, turns to face the way it's going, and plays idle / walk / sprint to match.
